name: Tabbouleh

recipeInstructions.text: Soak bulgur in water for 15 minutes, then drain and squeeze dry.
Finely chop all vegetables and herbs.
Mix parsley, bulgur, tomatoes, mint, and onions.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and allspice.
Pour dressing over salad and toss well.
Serve with romaine lettuce leaves as scoops.

keywords: tabbouleh, parsley salad, bulgur wheat, Lebanese salad
